name: Accessible Menu
description: Attaches the accessible-menu JavaScript library to core menu blocks to produce WCAG/WAI-ARIA keyboard-navigable menus, configured per menu.
library_dependencies: accessible-menu (NickDJM/accessible-menu, ISC) — loaded from a CDN (jsDelivr/unpkg) or a local /libraries copy
project_description: Accessible Menu wires Drupal's core menu blocks up to the accessible-menu JavaScript library (NickDJM/accessible-menu) so that rendered menus gain WAI-ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, and focus management without hand-writing any JS. It defines a plugin type for menu libraries, ships one library plugin plus four menu types (Disclosure Menu, Menubar, Top Link Disclosure Menu, Treeview), and adds per-menu configuration to the core menu edit form (menu type, collapsible toggle, open/close/transition classes and durations, hover behaviour). A site settings form chooses whether each library loads from a CDN (jsDelivr/unpkg, a configurable version) or from a local /libraries copy. The module supplies the behaviour and ARIA wiring only; it deliberately provides no CSS, so themers style the markup themselves. A Bootstrap 5 submodule adds a Bootstrap-flavoured library variant and navbar templates.
